flags: The official register supplies route branches, total length and designation date, but no road-construction narrative, driving character, travel time or route-specific scenic rationale. Overview stays short; nearby landscape history is clearly identified as such.
Dropped West Fayette County Rural Historic District boundary and William Conant House listing claims: the cached National Register page lacks its table.

The 6.295-mile designation includes both Van Meter and Rice connections to US 60; it is not established as a single through-drive mileage. Moments retain the Versailles Road-to-Old Frankfort Pike order; strip mileages do not locate the farm or track.

Manchester Farm is retained as a historic farm landmark explicitly treated as such by Keeneland, not as a business recommendation. No farm access or current development plans inferred from the 2022 purchase.
